fields.why: A number of trends on CITECT currently have incorrect / no scaling when right clicking on them to display the trend data. In all cases the default scale given is +/- millions causing the trend to always appear as a flat line if the scaling isn’t noted, which can catch people out when checking trends.
fields.design: Using the attached list update the scaling on all the required tags to ensure the data can be accurately trended.
fields.impact: Right-click trends in CITECT will show correctly scaled data.
